svg.title: Microsoft Channel Entry Route
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-01-microsoft-channel-entry-route; chapter number: 1; chart type: process_flow; title: Microsoft Channel Entry Route; subtitle: Partner Center to indirect CSP to Commerce Incentives; caption: Operators entering the Microsoft channel converge on one route, ending with a separate Microsoft Commerce Incentives enrollment.; assumptions note: Direct bill threshold of $1M trailing revenue reported as raised from roughly $300,000 effective October. License margin of 8-15% is before any service bundling.; note: Attributed to Pax8 APAC, Inside Microsoft AI Cloud Partner Program, m365 Show and Spyglass MTG.; stages: step: 01; label: Register Partner Center Account; value: Step 1; detail: Create the account and company profile under a domain email tied to the primary Entra tenant.; step: 02; label: Clear Business Verification; value: Step 2; detail: Pass business verification before attempting to transact.; step: 03; label: Join the AI Cloud Partner Program; value: Step 3; detail: Enrollment is free; benefits packages run $345 to $4,730 a year. Check the benefits tab before buying another security license.; step: 04; label: Link MPN ID to an Indirect Provider; value: Step 4; detail: More than 90% of partners run indirect through Ingram Micro, Pax8, TD Synnex or Sherweb, since direct bill demands $1M trailing revenue, a designation and paid support.; step: 05; label: Enroll in Commerce Incentives Separately; value: Step 5; detail: A benefits package or designation does not start incentive earnings on its own. Lock NCE seat counts and term inside the 7-day window.

circle.title: step: 01; label: Register Partner Center Account; value: Step 1; detail: Create the account and company profile under a domain email tied to the primary Entra tenant.

circle.title: step: 03; label: Join the AI Cloud Partner Program; value: Step 3; detail: Enrollment is free; benefits packages run $345 to $4,730 a year. Check the benefits tab before buying another security license.

Enrollment is free; benefits packages run $345 to $4,730 a year. Check the benefits tab before buying another security license.

circle.title: step: 05; label: Enroll in Commerce Incentives Separately; value: Step 5; detail: A benefits package or designation does not start incentive earnings on its own. Lock NCE seat counts and term inside the 7-day window.

text.title: A benefits package or designation does not start incentive earnings on its own. Lock NCE seat counts and term inside the 7-day window.
Assumptions: Direct bill threshold of $1M trailing revenue reported as raised from roughly $300,000 effective October. License margin of 8-15% is before any service bundling.
